semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Each task asks for closure of signed premises corresponding to the natural-deduction examples, including associativity, double negation, contraposition, excluded middle and classical implication principles.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-002 restores the ninth second-set task to two true assumptions, A-or-B and not-B, plus false A; the source had put both assumptions inside one signed-formula argument.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Deny the implication, witness the true existential at fresh a, remove the false negation to obtain a true universal, negate the witnessed not-A(a), and instantiate the universal at a to close.
semantic_review.finding: Eigenvariable ordering, constant choice, all signs and the seven-line closure are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Witness true existential A-and-B at fresh a, instantiate false existential C and true universal B-implies-C at a without checking them off, project B(a), then split the true implication into false B(a) or true C(a), closing both branches.
semantic_review.finding: The distinction between one-use eigenvariable rules and reusable closed-term rules, all checkmarks and both closes are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: First remove true negation, then branch on the true implication. Apply false-universal and true-existential eigenvariable rules before reusing true universal at b and false existential at c to close the respective branches.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-003 changes only the prose reference from line 3 to line 4, which is the false-existential node named by the rule and used as line 4 in the final tree.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The exercises cover quantifier distribution, negated quantifiers, a diagonal predicate construction, classical quantifier duality and existential instances of implications.
semantic_review.finding: All nine signed formulas, variable bindings and quantifier scopes are retained exactly.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma derives A when some finite list of formulas from Gamma, together with false A, has a closed tableau. Gamma is inconsistent when some finite list from it, all signed true, has a closed tableau.
semantic_review.finding: Finite-premise scope, signs, closure condition and the distinction between derivability and inconsistency are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: If A belongs to Gamma, the two-node false-A/true-A tableau establishes reflexivity. Any finite subset of Gamma remains a finite subset of a larger Delta, establishing monotonicity.
semantic_review.finding: Membership, subset direction, both signs and the closed two-node tree are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A closed tableau for false B, true A and the C premises is combined by cut on A with a closed tableau for false A and the D premises. The two resulting branches receive the respective old tableaux and both close.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-004 changes only D_m subset-of Gamma to D_m in Gamma; all finite premise lists, signs, cut branches and attachment directions are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: An inconsistent premise set derives every formula by putting its closed true-premise tableau below the false conclusion assumption. Both derivability and inconsistency are compact because their definitions already select finite premise lists.
semantic_review.finding: The explosive consequence and both finite-subset conclusions are rendered without strengthening their scope.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: One finite subset derives A and another finite subset becomes inconsistent when A is added. Cutting on A combines their two closed tableaux into a closed tableau for the union of the finite subsets.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-005 makes the C-list endpoint m agree with every later occurrence; all signs, sets and subset relations remain unchanged.

semantic_review.passage: provability iff inconsistency with the negation
semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A tableau beginning with false A can be replaced by one beginning with true not-A using the true-negation rule. In reverse, remove results depending on that assumption, add false A, and reconstruct any branch that had closed against false not-A.
semantic_review.finding: Both transformation directions, dependency removal, rule signs and closure cases are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: When Gamma derives A and already contains not-A, replace the false-A assumption by true not-A and derive false A from that true negation. Renumber references to the inserted result; the resulting tableau witnesses inconsistency.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-006 removes a stray standalone backslash. OLTAB-007 changes the prose operand from false A to true not-A, matching the named rule and its stated conclusion.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: If both Gamma with A and Gamma with not-A are inconsistent, cut on A after the shared finite premises. Attach the first tableau on the true-A branch and transform the second below the false-A branch, recovering closures that depended on true not-A when necessary.
semantic_review.finding: Every branch side, sign, dependency case and final contradiction is retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A true conjunction derives each conjunct by expansion, and two true conjunct assumptions derive their conjunction because false conjunction branches into a false copy of one conjunct on each branch.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-008 repairs only four malformed signed-formula calls across these trees; all signs, formulas, justifications and closes are unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: True A-or-B together with true not-A and true not-B is inconsistent. Either A or B alone derives their disjunction because expanding a false disjunction supplies both false disjuncts.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-008 repairs the remaining four malformed signed-formula calls; both branch alternatives and their closure dependencies are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: True A and true A-implies-B derive B. True not-A alone and true B alone each derive A-implies-B by expanding false implication and then closing against the relevant assumption.
semantic_review.finding: All implication signs, rule applications, branch structure and close markers are retained exactly.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma derives A of x and x is absent from every formula in Gamma, replace free x by a fresh constant in the old closed tableau. Add false universal-x A as the root and use the false-universal rule to obtain false A with that constant before attaching the renamed tableau.
semantic_review.finding: The freshness premise, uniform substitution, false-universal step and attachment construction are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A universal premise derives each closed-term instance by true-universal expansion, and any closed-term instance derives the corresponding existential because false-existential expansion yields the opposite signed instance.
semantic_review.finding: Both closed-term conditions, signs, binders, substitution terms and one-branch closures are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A structure or valuation satisfies true A exactly when it satisfies A, and satisfies false A exactly when it does not satisfy A. A set of signed formulas is satisfiable when one structure or valuation satisfies every member.
semantic_review.finding: Both truth signs, the pointwise set condition and existential satisfiability condition are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A tableau is satisfiable when at least one branch is satisfiable. Every rule extension preserves some satisfiable branch, while a closed branch contains opposite signs for one formula and therefore cannot be satisfiable.
semantic_review.finding: The induction direction, unchanged-branch case, nonbranching extension obligation and branching alternative obligation are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: True negation supplies false B, true conjunction supplies both true conjuncts, and false implication supplies true antecedent plus false consequent. The paired negation and disjunction cases remain exercises.
semantic_review.finding: Every sign, connective and semantic implication is retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: True universal preserves satisfaction at any closed term. For false universal, choose a falsifying assignment, reinterpret a fresh constant as its x-value, preserve all earlier branch sentences and obtain a false signed instance.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-009 replaces the copied B metavariable by A in five formulas so each premise, conclusion and semantic chain concerns one formula; all freshness and extensionality steps remain unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: False conjunction preserves at least one branch, true disjunction and implication are analogous exercises, and cut preserves whichever sign of B is satisfied. Closed-tableau soundness then yields validity, entailment and satisfiability-implies-consistency.
semantic_review.finding: Both branch alternatives, cut dichotomy and all three consequence directions are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Every closed term is identical to itself. True equality transports either a true or false signed instance from t1 to t2, requiring both the equality and the signed instance on the branch. The first worked tree closes by transporting true A(s) to true A(t).
semantic_review.finding: All closed-term restrictions, signs, two-premise references and the first complete tree are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: From true s1=s2 and reflexive true s1=s1, use A(x) as x=s1 to derive true s2=s1 and close against its false assumption.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-010 changes the prose description of line 3 from A(s2) to A(s1), matching the tree and the immediately following expansion.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Use true s2=s3 as the equality premise and true s1=s2 as A(s2), with A(x) equal to s1=x, to obtain s1=s3. The exercises ask for quantified substitutability and unique-existence tableaux.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-011 replaces the generic equality shown as the expansion of A(s2) by the actual s1=s2 on line 2; every tree node and exercise formula remains unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Reflexive identity is true in every structure. For true identity substitution, equality makes t1 and t2 denote the same object, so extensionality transports satisfaction of A(t1) to A(t2); the false case is parallel.
semantic_review.finding: OLTAB-012 specializes the added signed formula from arbitrary S to True in the case explicitly proving the true-identity rule. The equality, assignment and extensionality chain are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The driver currently treats every connective and quantifier as primitive except the biconditional, and includes quantified units only under the FOL tag before importing metatheory, soundness and identity.
semantic_review.finding: Every tag branch, import order, editorial limitation and the chapter hook are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A derivation from Gamma is a finite formula sequence in which each entry belongs to Gamma, is an axiom, or follows by an inference rule from one or two earlier entries.
semantic_review.finding: All three justification cases and both strict index inequalities are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: An inference rule gives a sufficient condition for a correct step. Premises and axioms yield immediate steps; modus ponens yields A when B-implies-A and B already occur earlier.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-001 restores the formula marker in the generic step A_i; the complete later formalization and all premise orders remain unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma derives A exactly when a derivation from Gamma ends in A. A is a theorem exactly when such a derivation starts from the empty premise set; the slash notation records non-theoremhood.
semantic_review.finding: Both definitions, the endpoint condition and positive/negative theorem notation are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The axiom set contains projection and pairing for conjunction, both disjunction injections and its eliminative schema, implication distribution and weakening, contraposition, explosion, truth, falsehood and double-negation elimination.
semantic_review.finding: All fourteen schemas, labels and metavariable positions are preserved exactly.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: If B and B-implies-A already occur in a derivation, A is a correct next inference step; MP abbreviates this rule.
semantic_review.finding: Both premises, their shared B and the A conclusion are retained without reversal.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: For any closed term t, a universal formula implies its t-instance, and the t-instance implies the corresponding existential formula.
semantic_review.finding: Closed-term scope, binder, substitution location and both implication directions are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: From B-implies-A(a), infer B-implies-forall-x-A(x); from A(a)-implies-B, infer exists-x-A(x)-implies-B, provided a occurs in neither Gamma nor B.
semantic_review.finding: The parameter condition, common context restriction and universal/existential directions are retained exactly.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Instantiate the disjunction axiom with not-D, E and D-implies-E. Supply its two antecedents from the negation-explosion and implication-weakening axioms, then apply modus ponens twice to reach the target.
semantic_review.finding: All five lines, three axiom labels, two MP references and the complete nested formula are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A direct use of implication weakening would require deriving D alone, so instead instantiate implication distribution with A and C both D and B equal to D-implies-D. Two weakening instances and two MP steps yield D-implies-D.
semantic_review.finding: The rejected strategy, metavariable choices and every line of the successful five-line derivation are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: From A-implies-B and B-implies-C, weaken the second hypothesis under A, instantiate implication distribution, and apply MP twice to derive A-implies-C.
semantic_review.finding: Both hypothesis markers, all seven formulas and all line references are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Concatenate arbitrary Gamma-derivations of the two links, append the reusable schematic chain lines and retarget their references to the last lines of the two component derivations. Exercises request conjunction commutation, currying and a negated-disjunction consequence.
semantic_review.finding: The proof transformation, reference update and all three exercise formulas are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Project each universal conjunct, instantiate both at the same fresh a, use conditional chaining twice, combine the instances through the conjunction axiom and MP, then apply the quantifier rule to generalize the consequent over x.
semantic_review.finding: Every binder, chosen constant, axiom reference, chain application, conjunction and final generalization is retained exactly.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Derivability ends a finite premise-relative sequence; theoremhood uses no premises; consistency is failure to derive falsehood. Reflexivity uses a one-line premise, monotonicity preserves a derivation under larger premises, and transitivity concatenates derivations.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-002 restores the marker on one B_i formula; every index, set direction and concatenation dependency remains unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: An inconsistent premise set derives every formula, and any derivation uses only finitely many premises from Gamma. Consistency compactness is the contrapositive at falsehood.
semantic_review.finding: Both directions, the finite witness selection and the falsehood specialization are retained.

semantic_review.passage: meta-modus ponens and deduction theorem forward direction
semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Meta-MP follows from the three-line derivation plus transitivity. If Gamma derives A-implies-B, monotonicity and reflexivity provide both premises over Gamma with A, so meta-MP yields B.
semantic_review.finding: All hypotheses, references and the forward implication are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: For a one-line derivation, B is a Gamma premise, the added A, or an axiom. For an MP final step, apply the induction hypothesis to C-implies-B and C, use implication distribution, and apply meta-MP twice.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-003 supplies B to the incomplete membership formula; every base case and induction formula remains intact.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The exercises cover implication chaining, contraposition, explosion and double-negation elimination both from a premise and under arbitrary Gamma.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-004 supplies the one missing outer closing parenthesis; all five labels and logical claims are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: When the final QR step derives C-implies-forall D, induction internalizes A into the earlier C-implies-D(a). A propositional theorem converts this to A-and-C-implies-D(a); QR generalizes D, and currying returns A-implies-(C-implies-forall D).
semantic_review.finding: The eigenvariable condition and all intermediate sequents are retained; OLAX-005 closes the currying schema and OLAX-006 states the required A-implies-B endpoint.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A derived A collapses any inconsistent extension by A. Gamma derives A exactly when Gamma with not-A derives falsehood, using weakening and explosion forward and deduction, double negation and DNE backward.
semantic_review.finding: Every implication direction, axiom reference and MP use is retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma derives A and contains not-A, explosion yields falsehood. If both A and not-A extensions are inconsistent, Gamma itself is inconsistent; its proof remains an exercise.
semantic_review.finding: Hypothesis roles and requested proof scope are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Projection uses the two distinct conjunction axioms; pairing uses the third. A disjunction plus both negations is inconsistent via two explosion conditionals and the disjunction axiom; either disjunct derives the disjunction by its injection axiom.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-007 changes the duplicate projection reference to ax:land2 and OLAX-008 changes the explosion reference to ax:lnot2; all formulas remain unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A and A-implies-B derive B by the explicit three-line MP sequence. Not-A derives A-implies-B by the negation axiom, and B derives it by implication weakening, together with the deduction theorem.
semantic_review.finding: Both proof routes, derivation lines and labels are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Internalize A(c) behind truth, apply QR because c is absent from Gamma and truth, then combine the resulting truth-implies-universal formula with the truth axiom by meta-MP.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-009 corrects only the final justification; freshness, formulas and conclusion remain unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A closed-term instance derives its existential generalization, and a universal formula derives each closed-term instance, by the corresponding quantifier axiom and the deduction theorem.
semantic_review.finding: Both tag branches, directions, terms and references are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Every axiom instance is semantically valid. In the displayed universal-instantiation case, satisfaction under all x-variants includes the variant assigning x the value of the closed term, and the substitution lemma yields the consequent; propositional instances can be checked by truth tables.
semantic_review.finding: The free-for condition, assignment update, term value, substitution and conditional direction are all retained.

semantic_review.passage: soundness induction basis and modus ponens
semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A derivation with no inference-justified steps ends in either an axiom or a premise, each entailed by Gamma. If the last step is modus ponens, the shorter prefixes semantically yield B and B-implies-A, hence A.
semantic_review.finding: Induction measure, both basis cases and both shorter derivation dependencies are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: From Gamma entailing C-implies-B(c), semantic deduction gives Gamma with C entailing B(c). For a model of those sentence premises and any assignment s, reinterpret the fresh constant c as s(x); the premises are unchanged, B(c) holds, substitution transfers this to B(x), and freshness transfers it back to the original model. Thus every assignment satisfies B(x), so the universal conclusion follows.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-010 restores the omitted formula marker on B(c). Freshness against Gamma, C and the universal formula, both extensionality uses and the arbitrary-assignment conclusion remain intact.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Theoremhood implies validity. If Gamma were inconsistent, it would derive falsehood; soundness would force every model of Gamma to satisfy falsehood, which no model or valuation can do, so satisfiability implies consistency.
semantic_review.finding: Both corollary directions and the contrapositive argument are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: For closed terms, reflexive identity and substitution of identicals are axiom schemas. Reflexive identity is therefore derivable over any premise set, and A(t2) follows from equality t1=t2 and A(t1) by applying the substitution axiom and modus ponens twice.
semantic_review.finding: OLAX-011 and OLAX-012 restore closed-term restrictions required by the stated axiom schemas; both schemas, references and the two-MP proof are otherwise unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The same chapter driver supports propositional and first-order completeness, with the first-order build additionally importing Henkin expansions, identity and downward Löwenheim–Skolem.
semantic_review.finding: Both chapter identifiers, all eleven imports, all three FOL gates and the final hook are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Semantic consequence implies formal derivability; equivalently, every syntactically consistent sentence set has a satisfying structure or valuation.
semantic_review.finding: The semantic-to-syntactic direction, model-existence equivalence and distinction between consistency and satisfiability are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Hilbert proposed that axioms which do not contradict one another together with their consequences can be treated as true and as defining existing objects; Frege rejected that view, while completeness vindicates only the stated model-existence sense.
semantic_review.finding: The historical disagreement, quotation scope and qualified 'at least in the sense' conclusion are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A finite derivation can use only finitely many premises, so any semantic consequence of Gamma is already a consequence of a finite subset; equivalently, consistency of every finite subset entails consistency of Gamma.
semantic_review.finding: Finiteness, subset direction and equivalent consistency statement are preserved without turning compactness into set-theoretic compactness.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The construction used for completeness can start with a finitely satisfiable sentence set to prove compactness directly; in first-order logic it also gives a finite or denumerable model for every satisfiable sentence set.
semantic_review.finding: The changed starting property, model-construction role, FOL-only gate and Löwenheim–Skolem cardinality conclusion are retained.

semantic_review.passage: perspective shift and atomic base model
semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Instead of constructing a derivation directly from semantic consequence, completeness is approached by constructing a satisfying structure or valuation from any consistent Gamma. Positive atomic sentences determine the predicate interpretation or propositional valuation.
semantic_review.finding: The semantic-to-syntactic direction, both FOL/propositional branches, natural-number domain, constant indices and truth assignment are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Consistency prevents both an atom and its negation from belonging to Gamma. Conjunction membership requires treating both conjuncts as present, while disjunction membership requires at least one disjunct.
semantic_review.finding: All negated satisfaction signs and both connective conditions are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Extend Gamma while preserving consistency and deciding every sentence, then exploit connective closure to prove the constructed interpretation satisfies the extension and hence Gamma.
semantic_review.finding: OLCOM-001 removes 'atomic' from condition (b), because the same paragraph and OLP-0129 define completeness as deciding every sentence. All other conditions and subset directions are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Add infinitely many witness constants without introducing inconsistency; interpret function symbols syntactically on closed terms; then quotient terms by the equalities required by Gamma so distinct syntactic terms may have the same value.
semantic_review.finding: Existential witness obstruction, constant-free languages, function arity, term construction, fixed identity semantics and arithmetic example are all retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Prove closure properties of complete consistent sets, add Henkin witnesses, apply Lindenbaum completion, construct the term model or valuation, establish the truth lemma, and factor by identity when equality is present.
semantic_review.finding: All tag-conditioned existential/universal claims and every stable cross-reference are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A sentence set is complete exactly when it contains each sentence or its negation. If also consistent, it contains exactly one of the pair and can determine the atomic part of the eventual structure or valuation.
semantic_review.finding: Every-sentence scope, exclusive consistency consequence and both interpretation branches are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Derivability from a complete consistent Gamma implies membership. Membership of conjunctions, disjunctions and conditionals is then characterized using the appropriate previously proved derivability properties, completeness and contradiction arguments.
semantic_review.finding: All four statements, both directions of each connective case, item references and proof-system-specific links are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Expand the language with countably many fresh constants and add an implication for each one-free-variable formula, so a true existential has a named witness or a false universal has a named counterexample.
semantic_review.finding: Both primitive-existential and defined-existential branches, the direction of implication, and the role of the fresh constant are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Adding countably many new constants preserves consistency. A set is saturated when every one-free-variable formula has a constant whose Henkin implication belongs to the set.
semantic_review.finding: The source and expanded languages, countability, membership conditions, free-variable scope, and both quantifier profiles are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Enumerate the relevant formulas and choose each c_n as the first added constant absent from the current formula and all earlier D_i, then form D_n with that constant.
semantic_review.finding: Every index, freshness exclusion, induction dependency and D_n formula is preserved exactly.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Adjoin D_n one at a time and take the union. If a stage became inconsistent, negating D_n would yield two opposed consequences; strong generalization turns the constant instance into a universal claim, contradicting consistency of the previous stage.
semantic_review.finding: The finite-stage argument, induction base and step, absence condition, four proof-system references and both quantifier branches are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: In a complete consistent saturated set, an existential belongs exactly when some closed-term instance belongs, and a universal belongs exactly when every closed-term instance belongs.
semantic_review.finding: Both directions of both equivalences, where saturation is and is not needed, the contradiction argument and all tagged derivability references are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Enumerate every sentence and at stage n adjoin A_n when doing so is consistent; otherwise adjoin its negation, then take the union of all stages.
semantic_review.finding: Every index, negation, union, consistency condition and case distinction is preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: If adjoining A_n is inconsistent, adjoining its negation must be consistent; otherwise the previous stage would itself be inconsistent by propositional exhaustiveness.
semantic_review.finding: The contradiction direction, induction hypothesis and all eight tag-conditioned proof-system references are retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: A separate induction shows every earlier stage is a subset of every later stage, using the base case, the immediate stage inclusion and transitivity of inclusion.
semantic_review.finding: The strict and non-strict index comparisons, both induction cases and all subset directions are preserved.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Every nonempty finite subset of the union lies inside one largest witnessing stage and is therefore consistent; the empty subset is consistent immediately, so compactness yields consistency of the union.
semantic_review.finding: OLCOM-002 makes the source's omitted empty case explicit before choosing a maximum index. All remaining memberships, subset relations and compactness references are unchanged.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Each sentence occurs at some index; if that sentence was not admitted, its negation was, so the final consistent union decides every sentence.
semantic_review.finding: The enumerated-sentence scope and the final negated alternative are preserved.

semantic_review.passage: FOL model and propositional valuation construction
semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: For FOL, extend Gamma to a complete consistent saturated Gamma-star and construct a term model; for propositional logic, use a complete consistent Gamma-star to assign truth values to propositional variables by membership.
semantic_review.finding: The tag-conditioned split, equality exclusion, extension relation, completeness, consistency and saturation assumptions are all preserved.

semantic_review.passage: four clauses of the term model
semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Use all closed terms as the domain, interpret each constant as itself, interpret a function by term formation, and put a tuple in a predicate extension exactly when the corresponding atomic sentence belongs to Gamma-star.
semantic_review.finding: All four clauses retain their arities, argument order, closed-term scope and biconditional.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Structural induction on a closed term shows its value in the term model is that same term: constants supply the base and the function clause supplies the induction step.
semantic_review.finding: The base case, induction hypotheses, function arity and all three displayed equalities are preserved. OLCOM-008 adds the source's missing empty false branch to the surrounding iftag.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Because every domain element of the term model is a closed term, an existential sentence holds exactly when one closed instance holds, and a universal sentence holds exactly when every closed instance holds; the assignment proof converts between A(x) and A(t).
semantic_review.finding: Both quantifier directions, variable-assignment scopes, extension reference and sentence independence reference are preserved.

semantic_review.passage: Truth Lemma base, atomic and Boolean cases
semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: Simultaneous induction proves satisfaction iff membership: falsity and truth use consistency and completeness, the atomic case uses the construction, and negation, conjunction, disjunction and implication use the induction hypothesis and complete-set laws.
semantic_review.finding: Every satisfaction polarity, membership polarity, Boolean alternative and tagged exercise branch is retained.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The universal case passes from satisfaction of forall x B(x), through every closed instance B(t), to membership of forall x B(x); the existential case uses at least one closed instance throughout.
semantic_review.finding: The source switches from B to A only in the universal case's final formula. OLCOM-003 restores B, matching the current induction formula and all preceding equivalences; the repair is disclosed beside the formula.

semantic_review.reverse_paraphrase: The ordinary term model makes distinct syntactic terms denote themselves, so it can falsify an equality sentence that belongs to Gamma-star; quotienting identifies exactly the terms that Gamma-star proves equal.
